title: finding(types): `FilterBuilderSchema.value` / `defaultValue` accept a bare CONDITION at validate while the TS face declares `FilterGroup` — the mirror is wider than the type
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a defect with named sites, class (c) — a metadata trap: an authored `filter-builder` node passes validation carrying a value shape the component cannot use. `reach:` public door, measured — `safeValidateSchema` answers success on the bare-condition value. Named producer: `@object-ui/types` `FilterBuilderSchema` in `packages/types/src/zod/complex.zod.ts`. Reader: the `domain:ui` seat #1 (seat post objectstack-ai/objectui#5560), which dispatches it after triage grades it, serial AFTER PR objectui#10823 (it edits the same file). Filed by that seat, `session_01DuWo5bdP9SdVebamn99GGk`, from the objectui#9306 dev report `5858138355`. ⛔ Not graded here.

## Sites (objectui `origin/main`, read by this seat)

- `packages/types/src/zod/complex.zod.ts:577-578` — `defaultValue` and `value` are each `z.union([FilterBuilderConditionSchema, FilterGroupSchema]).optional()`.
- `packages/types/src/complex.ts:582` / `:586` — the TS face declares `defaultValue?: FilterGroup` and `value?: FilterGroup`, a group only.

⇒ The authoring mirror admits a value the published type refuses.

## Measured (by the objectui#9306 dev, on its branch; the two lines above are identical on `main`)

- `safeValidateSchema` on a `filter-builder` node whose `value` is a bare condition `{ id, field, operator, value }` answers success.
- The component's `isValidGroup` gate needs `conditions` and `logic`, so a bare condition falls back to the empty group. The render half is a source reading, NOT MEASURED.
- The dev also noted, as a source reading and not measured, that the renderer passes `schema.value || props.value` and `FilterBuilder` has no `defaultValue` prop. ⇒ Whether `defaultValue` is read at all is a question for this card's first step, not a claim.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

Contract-first: the mirror follows the TS face (a group only), and a bare condition is refused loudly with a prescription (wrap it in `{ logic, conditions: [ … ] }`). Measure first whether `defaultValue` has any reader; if it has none, it is a declared-but-unenforced key and falls under enforce-or-remove.

## Dedupe

REST listing of the 500 most recently updated objectui issues and PRs, open and closed, grepped locally for `filter-builder … bare condition | value … union`, `FilterBuilderSchema … value|defaultValue`, `isValidGroup`, `EMPTY_GROUP`: 2 hits — PR objectui#10823 (the reporting dev's PR; it changes `FilterGroupSchema`'s nesting, not this union) and the closed PR objectui#10560 (the condition's `value` against `operator`, a different key). Neither carries this.

Dedupe words: `filter-builder value bare condition` · `FilterBuilderSchema value union FilterGroup` · `filter-builder defaultValue reader`
